description: Corrected main-store pass for Buddies Collectibles, LVLUP GAMING TCG, Otaku Vault, and GXGAMERS. Refreshes current WPN-backed event rows, clarifies non-WPN source dispositions, keeps Buddies/LVLUP/Otaku as useful but check-first candidates, and downranks GXGAMERS because its supported Commander lane is no-proxy/high-power/prize structured.
author: Codex Project Steward

fields.assessment_notes: Buddies remains a real Gardena TCG/community lead with a strong source stack: official site/events page, Linktree, Discord route, WPN, Yelp/review texture, Whatnot, and directory mirrors. Current WPN evidence is Commander-only: Friday 6:30 PM free casual Commander and Saturday 10:30 PM $10 Casual Commander Night. Keep it useful but check-first rather than a home-base assumption: the Discord first pass supports community scale but not Commander turnout, proxy norms, or solo-arrival comfort, and no current WPN draft, prerelease, FNM/constructed, or specials surfaced.

operations.reason: Refresh Buddies' Places synthesis after current WPN Commander-only confirmation.

positives: Close-ish Gardena TCG lead with official site, events page, Linktree, WPN, direct Yelp/review texture, and Discord route evidence.
Current WPN snapshot reconfirms both Friday free casual Commander and Saturday late-night Casual Commander.
Prior Discord first pass supports a sizable official community surface, even though Commander-specific texture remains unresolved.
cautions: Current WPN stream is Commander-only; no draft, prerelease/sealed, FNM/constructed, or specials surfaced in this snapshot.
Saturday 10:30 PM Commander is source-supported but may be practically awkward.
Discord/community evidence does not yet establish Commander turnout, proxy norms, or solo-arrival comfort.
open_questions: Do Friday or Saturday Commander reliably fire with casual pods?

operations.reason: Keep Buddies as useful but not over-promoted after corrected source/event closure.

fields.assessment_notes: LVLUP has real WPN-visible Magic breadth: Tuesday and Friday Commander plus The Hobbit prerelease, An Unexpected Crafting Party, 2HG Commander, Commander Party, and Magic Presents. It still reads as check-first because prior accepted evidence included an operating-reliability concern from a player report of arriving for a listed Companion event when the store appeared closed. No draft, Standard/Modern, rich review texture, or safely mapped Discord/community route was resolved in this pass.

fields.assessment_notes: Otaku Vault now reads as a real but still texture-limited Little Tokyo Magic candidate. Current WPN evidence supports Friday 6:00 PM FNM Commander with $5 entry/capacity 16 and unusually friendly store-written language, plus two Hobbit prerelease sessions, Commander Party, and 2HG Commander. Distance/traffic and lack of safely replayed Discord/social turnout texture keep it below closer home-base candidates, but it is useful to watch for specific specials.

fields.assessment_notes: GXGAMERS has real WPN-backed Magic activity, but it should be default-low for this project. Current WPN rows support Monday/Thursday/Saturday All Night Commander, Wednesday Standard Showdown, and The Hobbit prerelease. The Commander lane explicitly says Bracket 3 Casual, no proxies, Companion required, participation packs, prizing, and infinite combos after round 8, which makes it a poor fit for relaxed proxy-friendly Commander. Keep it as calendar truth and a possible Standard/prerelease lead, not a normal Commander recommendation.

operations.reason: Refresh GXGAMERS' Places synthesis and make the poor-fit no-proxy/high-power implications explicit.

positives: Current WPN snapshot confirms real organized-play activity: multiple weekly Commander nights, Wednesday Standard Showdown, and Hobbit prerelease sealed.
Official Magic page and Linktree/social route evidence are already captured.
Useful as calendar truth for Standard/prerelease awareness if a specific event matters.
cautions: Core Commander lane is explicitly no-proxy and prize/Companion structured, with infinite combos allowed after round 8.
The Commander description is a poor match for relaxed proxy-friendly casual Commander preferences.
Distance/parking/access and limited community/solo-arrival texture further reduce practical visit priority.
open_questions: Is there any lower-power or proxy-friendly community layer outside the WPN Commander rows?
Would Standard Showdown or prerelease be worth attending despite Commander mismatch?
Does the Discord/social route ever publish planning-relevant changes or a more casual lane?

operations.reason: Downrank GXGAMERS as a real but poor-fit/default-hidden Commander option rather than treating it as an ordinary recommendation.
